rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a restriction, boundary, or general state of being limited.

example.english: This rule has a limitation on contestants' age.
example.traditional: 呢個規定對參賽者嘅年齡有限制。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 kwai1 ding6 deoi3 caam1 coi3 ze2 ge3 nin4 ling4 jau5 haan6 zai3

rows.note: Use this for an inherent or structural limit on what something can do or encompass, especially in more formal contexts.

example.english: The limitation of this theory is that it cannot explain every situation.
example.traditional: 呢個理論嘅局限，係未能解釋所有情況。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 lei5 leon6 ge3 guk6 haan6 hai6 mei6 nang4 gaai2 sik1 so2 jau5 cing4 fong3

rows.note: Use this when the limitation is a defect or shortcoming that reduces usefulness or value.

example.english: The biggest limitation of this design is that it isn't practical enough.
example.traditional: 呢個設計最大嘅缺點係唔夠實用。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cit3 gai3 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 kyut3 dim2 hai6 m4 gau3 sat6 jung6
